note: The explainer video's input: its cut (intro, gallery, drop, wiring, chapters, shuffle, end), captions and the prep config the showcase scripts read; see the header of edit.py for the pipeline and what each section feeds, and shapes/explainer.py for how it becomes cuts.json. Relative paths are relative to the work dir; 'work' itself is absolute or relative to the repo root. Song keys are only names used in this file; copy this file to <work>/showcase.json and put the real audio paths in.

bed.note: drop = song time of the bass entering, on the bed's beat grid

clips.note: <dir>/<name>-<fmt>.mp4; window = song time at clip t=0 (the recorder already shifted for the app's reaction lag)

intro.note: Two shots from a screen recording, a camera move and a speed curve each. Camera keys: [t, point, width, swell]; a value that differs per format is {"h":..,"v":..}. Speed keys: [t, speed]; slow-mo is added around 'click'.

blur.note: other windows in the share picker

gallery.note: Gallery part then a scene part, source seconds. page / scene = the crop areas (x0,y0,x1,y1) without browser chrome. zoomIn eases from the whole page to the pointer; zoomOut eases the scene back to its framing; pointerRest = where the pointer sits on the scene (erased there).

tracking.note: Pointer templates: recording frames [at, x, y] where the pointer is clear of everything; the search box is where it can be

drop.note: [clip, bars] shots from the drop; each cut starts at the song time the drop has reached

wiring.note: t0 = song time at take t=0; the wiring starts where the drop shots end and runs 'beats' beats. Horizontal is one camera-moved take (camera.py makes 'cam' in the work dir); vertical cuts between two takes by [column, from beat, to beat].

chaptersNote: Optional feature chapters cut on the bed's grid right after the wiring: [{"id": "quickstart", "shots": [["clip", bars]]}]; each id is a caption anchor (a caption's from/to may name it). Empty: the v10 cut.

camera.note: Eased crops over the horizontal wiring take. Views are [centre x, centre y, crop width] in source pixels; keys are [clip time, view].

shuffle.note: Each shot starts at a strong bass hit of its own song: [clip, song, song time]

captions.note: Overlay captions. from/to = [anchor, offset seconds]; anchors: start, introCut (mic -> screen), introEnd, galleryEnd, wiringStart, shuffleStart. pos = where the text block sits per format.

items.small: Wire any signal to any setting

end.tag: Real-time music visuals in your browser
